keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «사람들이 레오가 또 거짓말한다고 생각해 양을 잃었다(사건)» 와 «거짓말을 하면 진실을 말해도 믿어 주지 않는다(교훈)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the event (the villagers thought Leo was lying again, so the wolf chased the sheep) and the lesson (people will not believe a liar even when he tells the truth). The green sentences are the answers.

boxes.a: Nobody believed Leo when a real wolf came.
People do not believe liars, even when they tell the truth.

sumHowto.ko: 먼저 위 세 칸을 보고, 빈칸에 알맞은 단어를 고르세요.
sumHowto.en: Look at the three boxes, then choose the right word for each blank.

qs.q: Why did nobody come when the real wolf came?
qs.qko: 진짜 늑대가 왔을 때 왜 아무도 오지 않았나요?
opts: They thought Leo was lying again.
They were afraid of the wolf.
evs: A young boy named Leo watched the sheep on a hill near his village.
The villagers thought he was lying again, so the wolf chased away many sheep.
Then one evening, a real wolf came out of the forest.
The villagers ran up the hill to help, but there was no wolf.
why: 마을 사람들은 레오가 또 거짓말을 한다고 생각했다고 본문에 나와요. 자고 있었다거나 늑대가 무서웠다는 말은 없어요.
The text says the villagers thought he was lying again. It does not say they were sleeping or afraid.

qs.q: "He played the same trick again." What does "the same trick" mean?
qs.qko: "He played the same trick again."에서 "the same trick"은 무슨 뜻인가요?
opts: shouting about a wolf when there was no wolf
playing a game with the sheep
evs: Then one evening, a real wolf came out of the forest.
One day, he felt bored, so he shouted, "Wolf! Wolf! A wolf is coming!"
Leo learned that when you tell lies, people will not believe you even when you tell the truth.
A young boy named Leo watched the sheep on a hill near his village.
why: 처음 장난은 심심해서 «늑대가 와요!» 하고 소리친 것이었어요. «같은 장난» 은 그 일을 또 했다는 뜻이에요.
The first trick was shouting «Wolf!» because he was bored. «The same trick» means he did that again.

qs.q: How do we know Leo's first shout was a lie?
qs.qko: 레오의 첫 번째 외침이 거짓말이었다는 것을 어떻게 알 수 있나요?
opts: He shouted because he was bored, and there was no wolf.
A wolf chased away many sheep.
Leo cried and asked for help.
evs: The villagers ran up the hill to help, but there was no wolf.
Leo shouted as loudly as he could, but nobody came this time.
One day, he felt bored, so he shouted, "Wolf! Wolf! A wolf is coming!"
The villagers thought he was lying again, so the wolf chased away many sheep.
why: 레오는 심심해서 소리쳤고, 사람들이 달려왔을 때 늑대는 없었어요. 두 문장을 이으면 거짓말이었다는 것을 알 수 있어요.
Leo shouted because he felt bored, and when the villagers came, there was no wolf. These two clues show it was a lie.

ends: Leo tells only the truth and slowly wins back trust.
레오가 진실만 말하며 조금씩 믿음을 되찾아요.
Leo and the villagers build a fence to keep the sheep safe.
레오와 마을 사람들이 양을 지키려고 울타리를 만들어요.

write.src: “I want to <u>tell the truth</u> because <u>people will believe me</u>.”
write.howtoKo: 예문을 틀로 삼아, 빈칸 두 곳을 «하고 싶은 일 + 그 이유» 로 바꿔 영어로 써 보세요.
write.howtoEn: Use the example as a pattern. Write what you want to do and your reason in English.
write.moreKo: 한 걸음 더: «I want to» 뒤에는 동사(read, go, help)를 바로 쓰고, «because» 뒤에는 «누가 + 무엇을» 을 쓰세요.
write.moreEn: One more step: after «I want to», write a verb (read, go, help). After «because», write who + what.
